svg.title: cobot-atlas: 42 representative meshes in seven robotics roles
svg.desc: Six meshes for each of seven roles, each rendered with the same studio lighting and scaled to fill its tile: robots and platforms, industrial components, tools and hardware, manipulation benchmarks, everyday objects, perception and calibration, and scenes and primitives. Each mesh was verified by SHA-256 against the dataset's pinned data tree.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: 6 representative meshes for each of 7 roles; one uniform studio render each, scaled to fill its tile.
Source: cobot-atlas (DOI 10.57967/hf/9199), revision 425eef2, data tree 9aaa11c; each mesh verified by SHA-256 and rendered with three.js.
